label: Hero Street Paintover Pass v1
historicalScope: Ancient Memphis, Early Dynastic / Old Kingdom, Kom el-Fakhry / Mit Rahina settlement evidence with early Ptah / Hwt-ka-Ptah endpoint.
purpose: A fixed visual target for improving the existing hero street composition, materials, and lighting without moving the approved district layout or adding more district content.
qualityTarget: Cinematic eye-height street composition: foreground frame, dense lane, clear vanishing point, authored ground, dark door interiors, contact shadows, warm sun, cooler shade, and restrained Old Kingdom material culture.

annotations.label: Overhead linen shadow frame
annotations.actionTarget: Darken and shape the existing awning/canopy read so the shot has a cinematic top shadow, but keep it simple linen/reed shade rather than decorative later-period fabric.
notes: Use shade and silhouette; do not add ornate New Kingdom tenting.
Should read as practical sun protection in a domestic lane.

annotations.label: Left foreground wall and object frame
annotations.actionTarget: Use the existing left facade, baskets, pottery, linen, and wall grime as close framing elements. Improve material depth instead of adding more props.
notes: Foreground materials must hold up from player eye height.
Keep baskets, clay, reed, linen, wood, and plaster historically restrained.

annotations.label: Right foreground human scale
annotations.actionTarget: Prefer one readable worker or carrier silhouette near the right third over many weak placeholders. Clothing stays plain linen, bare feet/simple sandals, minimal adornment.
notes: This is a composition target, not a request for more crowd density.
Motion should feel grounded and street-scale.

annotations.label: Clear lane spine and vanishing point
annotations.actionTarget: Keep the visitor eye pulled down the street center. Do not move the locked road or houses; use light, shadows, ground wear, and facade contrast to strengthen the axis.
notes: This is cinematic composition, not a confirmed street alignment.
The walking route remains centered and unobstructed.

annotations.label: Continuous packed-dust ground read
annotations.actionTarget: Break all visible tiling with a continuous authored ground read: compacted dust, darker traffic lane, footprints, ruts, straw, pottery chips, pebbles, and swept wall-base dirt.
notes: Ground should be sandy/tan with darker dirt where people walk.

annotations.label: Left doorway darkness pockets
annotations.actionTarget: Push existing door interiors nearly black with warm reflected jamb edges and stronger contact AO.
notes: A few dark pockets will make the sun feel brighter.
No ornate painted door program for ordinary street houses.

annotations.label: Right doorway darkness pockets
annotations.actionTarget: Match the right-side doorway darkness to the left side, so the lane reads as shaded interior volumes instead of flat wall decals.
notes: This should be material/light polish, not new architecture.

annotations.label: Wall-base grime and contact shadows
annotations.actionTarget: Strengthen baked-looking dirt and AO where walls, jars, benches, poles, baskets, and feet meet the ground.
notes: The effect must stay non-colliding and not recreate the transparent wall artifacts seen earlier.

annotations.label: Warm sun strips and cooler shade
annotations.actionTarget: Use diagonal awning and facade shadows to separate hot sun from cooler shade. Reduce flat white haze and one-note brown grading.
notes: Lighting is cinematic but should still feel like practical Egyptian sun and shade.

annotations.label: Two to three strong human silhouettes
annotations.actionTarget: Keep only a few readable humans in the canonical shot, with Old Kingdom domestic clothing and restored walking locomotion where applicable.
notes: Do not chase crowd count before silhouette quality.

paletteTargets.label: Warm low sun
paletteTargets.avoid: flat white haze or saturated orange wash

paletteTargets.label: Dusty plaster
paletteTargets.avoid: regular exposed block grid on ordinary house facades

paletteTargets.label: Packed Nile dust
paletteTargets.avoid: bright yellow carpet or repeated tile bands

acceptanceChecks: Paintover URL renders the overlay from the locked hero-street-main camera.
The district layout, road, houses, gates, and route coordinates remain unchanged during this pass.
Every visual target improves the existing hero street instead of adding new district content.
The target respects early Memphis / Old Kingdom restraint: mudbrick, plaster, linen, reed/wood, clay, packed dust, simple daily life.
No late New Kingdom, Ptolemaic, fantasy, or copied-media visual language is introduced.
Future screenshots can be compared against the same target zones and palette targets.
